move: round mark pops in, four rings radiate outward and fade, centre dot pulses a second ripple
how: A blue round SVG mark (disc, dark ring, centre dot) at the frame centre, four thin light-blue ring divs stacked behind it, and a tracked uppercase name below. 0-23%: the mark scales 0->1 with back.out(2.2). From 12% the rings expand scale .9 -> 3.2-4.7 (each 0.5 larger) while their border thins 6->1px and opacity fades to 0 (power2.out, 1.5s) with a 0.18s stagger. At 27% the name fades up 16px (power3.out). At 53% the centre dot's r grows 18->26 (power2.in) then springs back with elastic.out(1,.4), and one more ring fires at 57% (scale .9->3.6). Exit at 87%: the mark collapses to 0 with back.in(2) and the name lifts and fades.
adapt: Replace the mark SVG and blue (#4f8cff), the ring colour, the name text and dark background. Keep the back.out(2.2) pop, the 0.18s ring stagger with 1.5s power2.out expansion and the second beat at ~53%.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the centre group with four ring divs and the mark inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the pop at 0, rings from 0.12D, dot pulse at 0.53D, exit at 0.87D. Scope '.ring', '.mark', '.dot', '.name' to el; the from() tweens on mark and name need immediateRender:false when nested.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested
ends with the mark collapsed, no return to frame one
